scenario.zh: 提交可疑的数字材料，获得取证分析结果，判断内容是否为AI生成或被操纵
scenario.en: Submit suspicious digital material, receive forensic analysis results, and determine if content is AI-generated or manipulated

instruction.zh: 选择一种需要验证真实性的数字内容
instruction.en: Choose a type of digital content that needs authenticity verification

output.zh: 分析照片是否为AI生成或经过操纵
output.en: Analyze if photo is AI-generated or manipulated

input.zh: 车辆损坏照片：前保险杠凹陷，左前灯破裂，引擎盖有明显划痕
input.en: Vehicle damage photo: front bumper dented, left headlight cracked, hood with visible scratches

output.zh: 检测到多处异常：光照不一致，阴影方向冲突，边缘过渡不自然。高置信度判定为AI生成内容
output.en: Multiple anomalies detected: inconsistent lighting, conflicting shadow directions, unnatural edge transitions. High confidence determination of AI-generated content

output.zh: 检查文档是否被数字篡改
output.en: Check if document has been digitally altered

input.zh: 租赁协议第3条：月租金为2,800欧元，租期12个月，押金5,600欧元
input.en: Lease agreement clause 3: Monthly rent 2,800 euros, 12-month term, deposit 5,600 euros

output.zh: 数字金额区域显示字体不一致，压缩伪影异常，检测到后期修改痕迹。原始金额可能不同
output.en: Digital amount areas show font inconsistencies, abnormal compression artifacts, post-modification traces detected. Original amounts likely different

output.zh: 判断评价配图是否真实
output.en: Determine if review image is authentic

input.zh: 高端耳机产品照：黑色外壳，金属质感，品牌标识清晰可见
input.en: Premium headphone product photo: black casing, metallic texture, brand logo clearly visible

output.zh: 纹理重复模式异常，反光不符合物理规律，标识细节模糊。判定为AI生成的虚假评价图片
output.en: Abnormal texture repetition patterns, reflections inconsistent with physics, logo details blurred. Determined to be AI-generated fake review image

instruction.zh: 检查取证分析方法和置信度
instruction.en: Examine forensic analysis methods and confidence

output.zh: 光照一致性、压缩伪影、边缘分析、纹理模式四项独立方法均标记异常
output.en: Four independent methods flagged anomalies: lighting consistency, compression artifacts, edge analysis, texture patterns

output.zh: 综合评分显示强烈证据表明内容为AI生成，建议拒绝或要求提供原始材料
output.en: Combined scoring shows strong evidence of AI generation, recommend rejection or request original material

takeaway.zh: 示例展示了取证分析如何识别可疑特征。实际检测准确率需在Pixel Systems平台验证，并需人工审核关键决策
takeaway.en: Example shows how forensic analysis identifies suspicious features. Actual detection accuracy must be verified on Pixel Systems platform, and critical decisions require human review
